entities.summary: Hong Kong Baptist Hospital (HKBH) is a private Baptist hospital based in Kowloon Tong, Kowloon City District, Kowloon, Hong Kong. It is affiliated with the Baptist Convention of Hong Kong. Hong Kong Baptist Hospital is a hospital in Asia, established in 1963. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
